messages.content: How have you been feeling in general lately? Has your mood been pretty steady, or has it been kind of all over the place?
It’s been weird. Sometimes I feel okay, and then other times it hits me and I just want to stay in bed.
I hear you. When you think about what's coming up — whether it's next week, next month, or further ahead — how do you generally feel about it?
I don't really know. It feels like I'm just going through the motions, you know? I don't really have any idea what I'm doing.
That sounds really tough. How's your energy level been? Are you able to tackle tasks and activities, or do you find yourself dragging?
I'm tired all the time. I wake up and I'm already exhausted. It’s like my body just doesn't have the energy to keep going.
That sounds really tough. What kinds of things do you find yourself enjoying these days? Hobbies, time with people, specific activities — what brings you a sense of satisfaction?
I don't really have time for that right now. I just go to work and then come home and sleep.
I appreciate you telling me that. Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or eating habits lately? More, less, or about the same?
I haven't really eaten much. I guess I just haven't had the energy to cook or go out.
I hear you. Do you find it easy to focus on things — work, reading, conversations? Or has it been harder to concentrate lately?
It's hard. I read a sentence and then I forget what it said. I guess I just can't focus right now.
I appreciate you telling me that. Do you find yourself feeling guilty a lot? About things you've done, or sometimes just in general?
Yeah. I feel like I'm just failing at everything. I don't know how to stop it.
That sounds really tough. Have you found yourself getting more emotional than usual? Like tearing up or crying more often?
I cry a lot lately. I don't know why. It just feels like everything is breaking all the time.
Thank you for sharing that. Have you noticed yourself getting annoyed or irritated more easily than usual? Like snapping at people or feeling on edge?
Yeah. I get angry for no reason. It just feels like I'm walking around on the edge all the time.

It sounds like you're carrying a lot right now, and I really appreciate you being so open about everything you're experiencing. It takes courage to talk about these things, and I want to thank you for sharing your thoughts with me today. I hope things start to feel a little lighter for you soon.
